description.value: C Market Coffee takes its name from the global Arabica commodity exchange and has grown into a multi-location café chain across the Tri-Cities and Pitt Meadows area. The Pitt Meadows outpost sits at 19265 Airport Way and offers in-house-roasted coffee alongside fresh food, matcha, Korean Kkokdam tea, and baked goods. Beyond the cup, the business runs coffee classes, pop-up markets, and room rentals, positioning itself as a community hub as well as a quick-service café.
